title: Find a matching design approval
responsibility: Read approval records and select the latest approval that exactly binds a design version.

inputs.name: hubApproval.context
inputs.description: Authorized source context with repository, pinned commit, tree entries, source adapter and cache identity.

inputs.name: hubApproval.plan
inputs.description: Plan identity and folder containing the approvals.

inputs.name: hubApproval.value
inputs.description: Design version, contract hash, notes hash and image/option bindings to match.

outputs.name: hubApproval
outputs.description: Most recently timestamped matching approval, or undefined. Matching requires unit, version, contract, notes and the exact selected-option or single-design images.
